fusions.name: Shepherd's Nip
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stampede Rally
fusions.desc: Charges through every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage to each. When it lands, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Tend the Stragglers
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Huddled Close
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full), 8% more for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
